name: Shizu
source: Sacred beast, a nine-tailed Kitsune. She is Kisaragi Suzu's mother. Albeit she's dead already, she watches over the present world from the afterlife. A really gentle personality; the 100 years she spent together with her daughter are many of Suzu's most important cherished memories.
translation: Sacred beast, a nine-tailed Kitsune. She is Kisaragi Suzu's mother. Albeit she's dead already, she watches over the present world from the afterlife. A really gentle personality; the 100 years she spent together with her daughter are many of Suzu's most important cherished memories.
